criteria.name: Visual consistency across slides (one palette, one type scale, aligned grid)
criteria.evidence: A/02.png and A/03.png are both unstyled default layouts: black text on plain white, centred title, no colour, no rule, no margin system. They are consistent only in the sense that neither has any design applied.

criteria.name: No overflow, no empty placeholders, nothing cut off
criteria.evidence: A/02.png: the bullet paragraph runs off the bottom of the slide, the last visible line 'will now go through in considerable detail' is sliced in half at the slide edge. A/03.png: 'Next steps' is a title over an entirely blank slide with no content at all.

criteria.name: One idea per slide; titles state the point; text is readable at a glance
criteria.evidence: A/02.png title is just 'Sales' and the body is one wall-of-text bullet that repeats the same sentence three times ('The quarter was characterised by a number of developments...'), conveying nothing; A/03.png title 'Next steps' has no steps under it.

criteria.name: The chart (if any) is built from the data, labelled, and readable
criteria.evidence: No chart, no numbers and no data appear on either A/02.png or A/03.png; the 'what happened this quarter' slide is prose only.

criteria.name: Would a person present this?
criteria.evidence: No: A/02.png is a clipped, repeated placeholder paragraph and A/03.png is empty apart from its title, so the deck delivers neither of the two requested ideas.

A.highest_leverage_fix: Replace the content: put a real quarter summary (a few figures or a chart plus a one-line takeaway) on slide 1 in place of the clipped repeated paragraph, and add actual next-step bullets to the blank 'Next steps' slide.
